findings.title: Raw error.message leaked in API responses
findings.description: submit-real/route.ts and truth-enforcement/route.ts include raw error.message in 500 responses

findings.title: /api/download route is Public (unauthenticated)
findings.description: The download endpoint allows unauthenticated access with a TODO to gate it
findings.recommendation: Reclassify to Read tier and update frontend to send API key

findings.title: unsafe-eval and unsafe-inline in production CSP
findings.description: CSP script-src includes unsafe-eval and unsafe-inline, weakening XSS protection

findings.title: Verbose console.log in production routes
findings.description: Auto-pilot and resolve routes use console.log instead of structured logging
findings.recommendation: Replace with pino/winston structured logger with log levels

findings.title: No data subject rights endpoints
findings.description: Missing Right of Access, Erasure, Rectification, Portability endpoints for PII

findings.title: No privacy policy / data processing disclosure endpoint
findings.description: GDPR Article 13 requires informing data subjects about processing purposes

findings.title: Manual input checks instead of Zod schemas
findings.description: Some routes use ad-hoc checks instead of Zod validation
findings.recommendation: Migrate to Zod schemas for consistency

findings.title: No field-level encryption for PII
findings.recommendation: Implement application-level encryption for PII columns

findings.title: Prisma query logging may expose sensitive data
findings.description: Development mode logs all queries including data in WHERE clauses
findings.recommendation: Ensure dev DB instances contain only test data

findings.title: Audit logs in same DB as operational data
findings.description: Compromised app could tamper with audit records

overall_assessment: Strong security foundation. 1 high finding (now fixed). 0 critical vulnerabilities.
